Drawing libraries for lectures (served from this server, loaded only when a lecture contains a diagram or chart — assets/js/diagram.js)

  vega-lite.min.js     Vega-Lite 5.21.0            — BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE-vega-lite
  vega-embed.min.js    Vega-Embed 6.26.0           — BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE-vega-embed
  chart.umd.js         Chart.js 4.4.6              — MIT licence, (c) 2014-2024 Chart.js Contributors
Mermaid 11.4.1 (MIT) is in ../mermaid/.
